newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian govt budget meeting put back to Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Italian govt budget meeting put back to Thursday.

text.p: A meeting of government allies to discuss the 1997 budget, which was originally scheduled for later today, has been put back until Thursday afternoon, a spokesman at Prime Minister Romano Prodi's office said.
"The budget, which will be approved on Friday, is still the subject of technical appraisals between the prime minister and relevant ministers," Francesco Luna said.
"For this reason, the meeting called for 6.0 pm today...has been put back until tomorrow afternoon," he added.
